name: CMIP6 1pctCO2-bgc Earth System Model simulations
model_or_instrument: 10 CMIP6 ESMs (CESM2, CMCC-ESM2, MIROC-ES2L, NorESM2-LM, UKESM1-0-LL, BCC-CSM2-MR, CanESM5, CNRM-ESM2-1, GFDL-ESM4, IPSL-CM6A-LR)
resolution: grid-cell level at flux tower sites

scales.note: CMIP6 1pctCO2-bgc 140-year simulation from 10 ESMs (1% CO2 increase/yr to quadrupling).
